quotaHint: Counts the live files, the draft and the kept versions.

draft.title: Draft
draft.hint: Uploaded files replace the live ones only on activation. Try the draft with a preview first; activation renders it in both languages and changes nothing on an error.
draft.pathHint: Lowercase letters, digits and . _ -, at most one folder (e.g. fonts/inter.ttf). Extensions: .typ, .toml, .ttf, .otf, .woff2, .svg, .png, .jpg, .jpeg.
draft.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
draft.confirmDiscard: Really discard all changes of the draft?

history.title: Version history
history.hint: The 10 newest versions are kept. Restoring replaces the live files with the version; the draft stays as it is.
history.author: Author
history.confirmRestore: Restore version {number}? The live files are replaced with its content.
history.confirmReset: Delete all custom files and use the default design? Restoring a version undoes it.
history.resetDone: The default design is in use.
